class.name: PsychConductor
class.brief_description: A high-precision step, beat, measure, and section clock with piecewise tempo changes.
class.description: [PsychConductor] maintains a double-precision song clock, a sorted BPM map, and step-based callbacks. It can be driven by Godot frame time or synchronized to an external audio position. Tempo changes are specified in absolute milliseconds; their beat and step positions are recalculated when the map changes.

method.name: set_tempo_change
method.description: Adds or replaces a tempo change. Returns [code]false[/code] for a negative time or a non-positive/non-finite BPM.

method.name: set_tempo_map
method.description: Atomically replaces the tempo map. Each dictionary must contain [code]position_ms[/code] (or [code]time_ms[/code]) and [code]bpm[/code].

method.name: seek
method.description: Moves the song clock. Optionally emits timing signals for the step at the destination.

method.name: synchronize_to_audio_position_ms
method.description: Applies a small proportional correction for low drift and a hard resynchronization for drift beyond [member max_audio_drift_ms].

method.name: start
method.description: Starts advancing the clock and emits the current unreported step.

method.name: reset
method.description: Moves the clock to zero and resets the emitted-step cursor.

method.name: get_step_at
method.description: Converts an absolute time in milliseconds to a fractional step using the active BPM segment.

method.name: get_step_start_time_ms
method.description: Converts a fractional step to its absolute time in milliseconds.

members.member: The BPM at song time zero.
The current song position in milliseconds.
Clock multiplier. A value of zero pauses the clock.
Drift threshold above which audio synchronization performs a hard seek.
Number of steps between [signal section_hit] events.

signal.name: step_hit
signal.description: Emitted for every newly crossed step, starting at step zero.

signal.name: section_hit
signal.description: Emitted at the configured section boundary.

signal.name: tempo_map_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the tempo map changes.

signal.name: audio_resynchronized
signal.description: Emitted after a hard correction to the audio clock.
